mission.name: Hold Out: Feeding Frenzy
mission.description: Hold Out. Symbiotes boil out of the vents round the station atrium: crawlers and hosts first, Puppeteers from round 8, Amalgams from round 12. They burn. Survive as long as you can - there's no win. Your best round is remembered.
